notes.title: Team Indie nominated for German Game Developer Award 2014
notes.notes:
[img]http://files.bsgam.es/TeamIndiedep2014nominationbig.png[/img]

Team Indie has been nominated for the German Game Developer Award 2014 in two categories. We are humbled to be nominated for "[b]Best Action Game 2014[/b]" along big titles like "Lords of the Fallen" and "Ryse: Son of Rome". Moreover Team Indie is also competing for the "[b]Innovation-Prize 2014[/b]" which is awarded to outstanding new experiences.

notes.title: Team Indie - Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
We listened to our players and further improved the game experience!
[list][*][b]Dustforce controls improved.[/b] Smoother controls and it should be a lot easier to stick to the leaves in certain situations!
[*][b]Treasures now displayed on map.[/b] You can now see if you are missing a treasure in a certain level, by selecting the level on the map!
[*][b]Boss 2 collision bug fixed.[/b] Sometimes it happened that the boss 2 colider got misplaced.That will not happen anymore. Boss appearance now matches collider.
[*][b]Level design improved.[/b] Smaller changes were made to over 30 levels at formerly very tricky parts to improve the experience.
[*][b]Additional small bug fixes.[/b]
[/list]
